qodget.prompt:
Create one polished English-language brand identity concept for a small Windows desktop AI quota and usage widget named exactly "Qodget". Natural canvas 1536 × 1024, horizontal, production-quality logo presentation, not a website or app UI. The name fuses Quota + widget, and subtly sounds like a compact gadget. Exact secondary text: "Quota + widget". Exact short descriptor: "AI usage, within reach."

Reference image 1 is the actual mark from the officially installed OpenAI Codex / ChatGPT app. Use it ONLY to understand the user's requested family resemblance: continuous woven strokes, rounded precision and deliberate negative space. Do not reproduce the six-lobed blossom, its central hexagon, or merely recolor it. Reference image 2 is the existing quota-analysis app, provided ONLY as product context. Do not reproduce that UI in this image.

ART DIRECTION — folded terminal knot. Design an original compact emblem in which TWO broad folded ribbons interlock into a rounded, slightly asymmetric Q-shaped enclosure. The lower-right exit of the ribbon resolves into a subtle terminal-prompt tail, making a connection to code and to a small utility window. There must be clear over-under logic and a small open center; no six-petal floral arrangement. The outside silhouette should feel designed and memorable, with tension between a soft rounded corner and one purposeful angular fold. It should be richer and more considered than a plain circle, bracket pair, split disc or generic Q monogram. Avoid stock crop marks, generic sparkle/star, robot, chip, battery, chain link, and busy technical decoration.

Give the primary mark an elegant satin ice-blue to cobalt finish with very restrained depth, as an expertly crafted desktop app emblem. No neon glow, heavy chrome or glossy toy appearance. Pair it with a beautifully kerned, friendly geometric wordmark "Qodget" in near-black. Design the logo first; the wordmark should complement rather than dominate it.

PRESENTATION: warm near-white clean background, generous white space. Main emblem large at left-center, wordmark and the two short lines at right-center. A quiet bottom proof area repeats THE EXACT SAME emblem as flat black on white and flat white on charcoal, plus one modest app-icon treatment using the same geometry. These are applications of ONE logo, never different ideas. No option numbers, Chinese characters, extra names, official OpenAI words/logos, legal fine print, grid ornament, arrows, annotations or decorative filler. The flat proofs must remain bold and legible at small scale. Fit every element cleanly inside the canvas. The result should look like a premium designer's identity proposal, with intelligent form, clear product relevance and typographic polish.

quotlet.prompt:
Create ONE exceptional English-language logo and naming concept for a Windows AI quota companion named exactly "Quotlet". Canvas: 1536 × 1024 horizontal. This is a premium brand identity presentation, not an app screen, website, infographic or collection of alternate logos. The name is Quota + applet. Include exact small text "Quota + applet" and the short descriptor "A clear view of your AI quota."

Reference image 1 is the actual officially installed OpenAI Codex / ChatGPT mark. The user explicitly wants a visual relationship to that family, while having an original logo. Use its thoughtful interweaving, circular rhythm and balance of straight/curved segments as inspiration. Do NOT reuse or trace its six-lobed flower, exact weave, hexagonal hole or official wordmark. Reference image 2 is the current quota-analysis app only for product context; no UI from it belongs in the output.

ART DIRECTION — a woven quota Q. Make a distinctive Q emblem out of THREE broad continuous interlocking strokes. Their path should establish an open, near-circular perimeter and a confident tapered Q-tail pointing lower-right. The negative center should be a softly squared counter, not the official logo's hexagon. One deliberate break between strokes suggests remaining capacity and periodic replenishment, but it must feel like an inherent part of the letterform, not a generic progress ring. Preserve true over-under construction with clean gaps. Explore the elegance of a compact woven seal while ensuring the first read is Q / quota, not a flower or an unmodified ChatGPT mark. No stock knot clone, infinity symbol, crop brackets, split circle, generic star, chip, battery, chart or illustration.

Use deep emerald / fresh jade as a single controlled accent, supported by ink black and warm white. Primary emblem can have a subtle satin relief and restrained highlight along one edge, but its underlying FLAT silhouette must be the design's strength. Refined curves, deliberate weight, beautifully resolved joints. Typography: the exact wordmark "Quotlet" in a bespoke-feeling humanist sans serif, crisp and confident, carefully kerned, softer than a generic software monospaced font.

COMPOSITION: main original emblem centered slightly above the middle of the canvas, generous scale; large wordmark and the concise name-origin line below it, no crowded headers. Along the bottom, show small flat-black and reversed-white proofs of THE EXACT SAME mark, plus a restrained desktop app-icon application. Those are applications of one identity, NOT alternate concepts. Keep the monochrome proof clearly visible and consistent with the hero. No Chinese, no option labels/numbers, no official OpenAI branding or claims, no legal footer, texture, decorative ruler, fake device mockup, badges or interface cards. Present with quiet luxury, spacious hierarchy, and compelling product meaning.

codexlet.prompt:
Create a single premium English-language brand identity concept for "Codexlet", an independent compact desktop companion that shows AI coding quota, remaining capacity and reset times. The coined name is Codex + applet. Exact wordmark: "Codexlet". Exact small supporting text: "Codex + applet". Exact descriptor: "Your coding quota, at a glance." Canvas is 1536 × 1024 horizontal. Produce one coherent identity concept, not a website, dashboard or set of alternative logos.

Reference image 1 is the actual mark shipped in the officially installed OpenAI Codex / ChatGPT app. Reference image 2 is the existing quota-analysis app solely as product context. The user's desired relationship to the ecosystem should be recognizable through confident monochrome geometry, continuous paths and code symbolism. Do not put the official logo in the output, reproduce the six-loop blossom, or copy the app screenshot.

ART DIRECTION — code folded into a mark. Invent a striking compact C/X ligature: an open, broad C-shaped ribbon folds through an angular negative-space X / code cut at its core, and terminates in a short, purposeful baseline reminiscent of a terminal cursor. Balance a fluid outside with precise interior angles. It should be one connected, intelligible form with a distinctive silhouette, neither a plain C nor two detached brackets. A subtle pair of different path lengths may allude to the short and weekly quota windows. Keep the number of elements extremely disciplined; no tiny ornamental marks. This option should feel more clearly like a Codex companion and coding instrument than the softer woven Q directions.

Give the primary mark a beautiful graphite / midnight-ink appearance with one restrained cool-blue edge accent. Not a generic rainbow gradient. One embossed or satin-metal large application is welcome, with thoughtful directional light, but show a clear FLAT mono rendering as the actual logo. No gaudy chrome, neon, glass sphere, flower, hexagon badge, chip, battery or bar chart. Typography should be elegant and contemporary, with a slightly technical character and deliberate custom kerning in "Codexlet"; do not use stock terminal monospace or imitate an official OpenAI wordmark.

PRESENTATION: a sophisticated pale cool-gray studio field. The large primary emblem sits at upper-left/center and an oversized but refined wordmark sits to its right. The two brief supporting lines have a clear, quiet hierarchy beneath the name. Along the lower region, repeat THE EXACT SAME emblem in solid black, reversed white on dark, and a clean square desktop app-icon application. These must be consistent applications of ONE mark, never different directions. Give everything breathing room, honest optical balance, and crisp contours that can later be reproduced at 24px. No Chinese, option labels, numbers, extra product names, official logos, ornamental UI panels, devices, legal text, watermarks or explanatory arrows. A designer-grade, distinctive, simple-but-not-simplistic identity proposal.
